capabilities: Plan weekly routines in a timetable-style editor
Store routines in a fenced weekly-routine block in a note
Manage categories with rename, recolor, and delete
Configure start hour, end hour, and hour height in settings
disambiguation: Meant for recurring weekly structure, not dated calendar events or one-off schedules.
extras: The plugin is desktop-only. Category definitions are stored in plugin settings, while notes only keep category tags such as #daily-routine.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan and edit a recurring weekly structure as a timetable inside a note.
summary: Weekly routine planner with a timetable-style editor that stores recurring weekly routines in a fenced block inside a note.
